topLevel.why: X consistently presents whole stories under their actual titles, keeping their afterwords attached. Y fragments Human Readable across several parts and separates Epoch's title and advertisement from its story, mislabeling the title as an epoch marker; X's misplaced boundary before the final essay's body is a smaller defect.

gists.why: X better locates the hotel research, webcam surveillance, control negotiations, and BIGMAC's anticipated shutdown, and gives a substantially more informative afterword gist. Y is more useful for the narrowly focused rescue and bill-introduction passages, while both adequately describe the encounter inside Buhle.

overall.why: X offers a clearer story-level map and more useful gists on most sampled passages. Y's occasional advantage in local specificity does not outweigh its fragmented top level and several gists focused on events other than the sampled passage.
